haller_lake_whole_house_interior.heading: Whole House Interior Remodel in Haller Lake
haller_lake_whole_house_interior.text1: A whole-house interior remodel in Haller Lake with accessibility-focused bathrooms, custom woodwork, and a renewed front entry.
haller_lake_whole_house_interior.text2: The remodel connects the living spaces with two updated bathrooms, custom cabinetry, and a wood floor vent integrated into the hardwood.
haller_lake_whole_house_interior.short2: Whole House Interior Remodel in Haller Lake
haller_lake_whole_house_interior.text3: Living spaces, custom woodwork, accessible bathrooms, and a renewed entry.

part1.text2: Hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, large windows, and two skylights define the main living space.

part2.small_heading: Hardwood flooring and an open connection to the hallway
part2.text2: Hardwood flooring and a wide interior opening connect the living area with the hallway.

part3.small_heading: A custom hardwood floor vent shows the level of finish work
part3.text2: A custom wooden floor vent demonstrates the level of care carried into the finish work. Rather than using a standard metal vent, the vent was built into the hardwood so it reads as part of the finished floor.

part4.small_heading: A guest shower with a bench and grab bars
part4.text2: The glass shower includes a built-in bench and grab bars, alongside a custom vanity.

part6.small_heading: A wheelchair-accessible vanity and recessed medicine cabinets
part6.text2: The double vanity includes space beneath one sink for wheelchair access and recessed medicine cabinets. A wall-mounted toilet keeps the tank concealed in the wall.

part7.small_heading: A curbless shower with grab bars and warm-air drying
part7.text2: The primary shower has curbless access, grab bars, two shower heads, and an in-shower warm-air drying system.

part8.small_heading: A new front door completes the entry
part8.text2: The new front door gives the entry a finished look.
